objective: Run the byte-exact frozen H6 package from training through evaluation on one uninterrupted persistent-storage destination, opening development only if both selected checkpoint hashes reproduce exactly.
authorized_actions: reuse retained RunPod network volume 04himzqxbm in EU-RO-1
create one secure RTX 5090 pod with the frozen image
stage the frozen development-free H6 package in a no-clobber isolated root
run the frozen two-seed H6 training recipe
back up and authenticate training artifacts before development release
release development once only after both selected checkpoint hashes match the original freeze
run the unchanged evaluator on the same uninterrupted pod
back up the terminal result twice and terminate compute
prohibited_actions: modify the H6 model, data, recipe, selector, evaluator, verifier, or gates
open development after any checkpoint hash mismatch
restart the original stopped source pod
access fresh-v1, sealed confirmation, benchmarks, or private corpus data
run product, app, UI, service, or deployment work
termination_rule: The new compute pod is terminated after failure evidence or two verified terminal-result backups. Persistent storage remains until off-provider verification is complete.
